additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Skyros · original official brochure and grouped home drawings

review.imagery: Twenty-one own-project renders cover the complete tower, podium, roof, pools, shared spaces and home interiors. All 44 extracted brochure resources and six current gallery images were visually reviewed. Generic Greek-island/people/city photography, blue decorative layers and unpainted drawing/image layers are excluded. The current primary full-building image supplies the hero and card. Proposed finishes and views remain unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Eleven complete source sheets show five home variants and three building floorplates. The official brochure groups the home variants on three dark-blue sheets. The broker-hosted branded floor pack supplies five individual home sheets and ground, first and second-to-seventeenth-floor overviews. The ground sheet depicts retail and outdoor retail areas. Numerical unit areas and numbered-unit matching are not stated on these drawings. Confirm the approved configuration, contractual area and pool provision with SAMANA. All three complete official drawing pages 36–38 and eight mirror pages 2–9 were visually reviewed. Ground-floor retail scope and exact second-to-seventeenth-floor grouping are preserved. No area is inferred from room dimensions, current category minima or portal ranges. Full source branding and physical page links remain available.
review.location: The complete original map on physical page 34 was visually reviewed. Conflicting brochure values and the duplicated Autodrome label are explicitly qualified. Sixteen current-primary driving ranges are transcribed. The official name-only map query is recorded with HTML hash. No coordinate or plot-frontage claim is inferred.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, official brochure bytes, native image origins and the broker-hosted branded nine-page plan PDF retain source receipts and hashes. The REM source remains labeled as a broker mirror. Complete pages retain original content and branding. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, approved unit matching, final fitout/views, exact visitor entrance coordinates, resolution of the duplicated map destination and dated construction photographs were not established.
